_comment: Gate replay 3 (M3): per_category_caps enforcement, rendered. The ui bus fills exactly to its cap (8 hud_pings, 3-tick spacing = 44 cycles at 880 Hz -> phase-coherent sum), while a priority-10 sfx drone - the GLOBAL steal chain's preferred victim - and two sfx fillers sit in the pool with 50+ free slots. The 9th ui cue (toll_paid, priority 50) must steal IN-CATEGORY: victim = oldest ping, not the drone, and never a free slot. The 7/8 ratio window sits AFTER the short toll ends: with caps unenforced the toll would take a free slot, all 8 pings would survive, and the ratio would read 1.0 (> 0.92, FAIL). Windows are 4800-frame Goertzel bins (10 Hz); 880/500/2100/400 all bin-aligned.
name: replay_ui_cap

goertzel._drone_survives_the_steal: in-category selection ignored the global-best victim

ratio._steal_leaves_7_of_8: post-toll window vs pre-steal window = 7/8 = 0.875; 1.0 here means the cap did not bind

log._the_steal_tick: exactly one victim stop at tick 40

log._and_nowhere_else: no other voice in any category is ever stopped
